distribution.summary: 辽宁；吉林；陕西；四川；云南；山西；新疆
distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) reported 辽宁，吉林（抚松），陕西（沔县），四川（南江），云南. 黄复生等 (2015) reported 辽宁，吉林，陕西，四川，云南，山西，新疆. These are literature-based reports; the mainland-China occurrence assessment remains Candidate pending checklist review.

host_note: Host names are retained as published, with separate source citations for 1984 and 2015; the latter may repeat earlier evidence rather than represent independent host confirmation. Host associations have not yet undergone independent review.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Orthotomicus suturalis (Gyllenhal, 1827).
